extensionDescription.message: Automatically back up and restore tabs, windows and groups. Local-first, no account. Export backups to keep a separate copy.

privacy.message: Your tab data stays on this device.

unchanged.message: No changes since your last backup.

search.message: Filter saved snapshots by title or URL

empty.message: Your next fresh start begins here.

emptyBody.message: Create a backup to save your open tabs, windows and groups.

automaticHelp.message: Save changes after a short pause, with a recovery check every 15 minutes.

retentionHelp.message: Free keeps your latest $1 distinct snapshots. Older snapshots expire when new ones are saved.

storageHelp.message: $1 MiB of $2 MiB application budget. Browser quota also applies.

localWarning.message: Internal backups are removed if you uninstall TabBackup. Export a file for a separate copy.

urlWarning.message: Backup files are unencrypted. URLs and titles can contain sensitive information. Keep exported files private.

limits.message: Restores open new windows. Unsaved forms, page state, scroll position and lost sign-ins cannot be recovered. Internal pages and unsupported URLs are skipped. Restored sites may load over the network.

restoreDetails.message: Skipped: $1 unsupported URLs. Failed: $2 tabs. Verified: $3 tabs. Warnings: $4.

interrupted.message: Restore was interrupted. Counts reflect confirmed progress only. Check opened windows before trying again.

restoreRunning.message: A restore is in progress. Keep Chrome open.

confirmDelete.message: Delete this snapshot? This cannot be undone.

confirmDeleteAll.message: Delete all snapshots? Export a copy first if you want to keep them. Automatic backups can create new snapshots afterward.

importImpact.message: $1 snapshots will be added; $2 duplicates skipped; $3 ID conflicts renamed; $4 snapshots removed by retention.

downloadStarted.message: Backup file download started. Check your downloads.

invalidBackup.message: This backup file is invalid or unsupported.

storageError.message: Backup couldn't be saved. Storage is unavailable. Your existing backups have not been intentionally removed. Try again or export a copy.

migrationError.message: Some stored backups use an unsupported or damaged format. Data has been preserved. Keep this extension installed and contact the publisher before changing storage.

quotaError.message: Backup couldn't be saved. The storage budget is full. Export your backups, then remove older snapshots and try again.

captureError.message: Your tabs changed during backup. Automatic backup will retry; you can also try again.

emptyBackup.message: There are no supported tab records to back up in normal windows.

genericError.message: Something went wrong. Try again. If a restore was running, check its status before retrying.

busy.message: A restore is already running. Please wait.

onboardBody1.message: TabBackup automatically saves your open tabs, windows and groups.

onboardBody2.message: Your browsing data stays on your device. No account. No cloud upload.

onboardBody3.message: Automatic backups are enabled. Create a first snapshot and export important backups for safekeeping.

incognito.message: Incognito windows are excluded. TabBackup does not access page content, cookies or site storage.

persistence.message: Ask browser to protect local storage

persistent.message: Browser storage persistence granted. Exported copies are still recommended.

notPersistent.message: Persistence was not granted. Export important backups regularly.

verifiedHelp.message: Verification checks Chrome tab structure immediately after creation; it does not verify page content or successful site loading.

privacyBody.message: No account, cloud upload, remote analytics, advertising or sale of data. TabBackup stores tab URLs and optional titles, pinned state, order, and window/group structure solely to back up and restore your tabs. Recognizable URL credentials are redacted; other sensitive URL information may remain.

previewChanged.message: Your backup library changed after the preview. Choose the file again to review the updated import.
